The '''Ender Chest''' is a storage feature that allows players to store items that can be accessed globally. It can be accessed in the [[SkyBlock Menu]], interacting with a physical {{Item|Ender Chest}}, or through the {{Code|/enderchest}} or {{Code|/ec}} commands.

By default, the Ender Chest only has 54 slots for items, but can be upgraded at the [[Community Shop]].

== Usage ==
The Ender Chest is used to store items of any kind, except items that can store other items (e.g. {{Item|Builder's Wand}}). This can be useful if the player's inventory fills up often from grinding. It can be accessed from anywhere, and can be upgraded to have up to 10 pages (405 slots, or 25,920 items in stacks of 64).
